A Clear, Supported Journey to Healing
Starting Your Recovery is Simple

blocks.html: Starting your recovery shouldn’t feel overwhelming. Our team has designed a straightforward, four-step process to get you the specialized support you need as quickly and comfortably as possible.

What to Expect
The Dallas Detox Center Experience

blocks.html: Your journey begins with a warm welcome to our private Dallas estate, where your comfort and safety are our immediate priorities. During your first 24 hours, our clinical team provides a medical evaluation and orientation to ensure your transition into our medical detox or residential programs is seamless. We focus on immediate stabilization in a secure environment, allowing you to settle into your private suite and begin your recovery with peace of mind.

blocks.html: Beyond the initial intake, you will engage in a structured, evidence-based program that addresses the root causes of addiction through physician-led therapies such as Individual or Equine Therapy. Our philosophy centers on treating the whole person, integrating specialized tracks for professionals, veterans, and more, with holistic wellness practices. This clinical partnership is designed to provide you with the practical tools and emotional resilience needed for long-term wellness and a successful return to daily life.

Safe and Seamless Logistics from Anywhere in the Country

blocks.html: Distance should never stand in the way of high-quality clinical care. Whether you are traveling from across the state or flying in from across the country, our admissions team is here to handle your travel logistics. From coordinating private pickups at DFW or Love Field to assisting with local transportation, we manage the details of your arrival to ensure your journey to our Dallas campus is as safe, comfortable, and stress-free as possible.

Protecting Your Career While You Prioritize Your Health
Job Protection & FMLA Assistance

blocks.html: Many people avoid life-saving treatment because they fear they will return home to an empty desk. It is important to know that federal laws, such as the Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA), were created specifically to protect your job during a medical crisis, including addiction and mental health recovery. These laws allow you to take a protected leave of absence without the risk of being fired, ensuring your position is waiting for you when you finish your program.

Frequently Asked Questions
How soon can I begin treatment?

blocks.html: We understand that the need for help is often urgent. Our admissions team is available 24/7 to begin your consultation, and in many cases, we can coordinate same-day or next-day admissions once your clinical assessment and insurance verification are complete. Call us now at 817-904-2197 to get started.

Is the admissions process confidential?

blocks.html: Absolutely. Every conversation, screening, and piece of documentation is 100% confidential and HIPAA-compliant. We prioritize your privacy from the very first phone call through your entire stay at our facility.
blocks.text: Absolutely. Every conversation, screening, and piece of documentation is 100% confidential and HIPAA-compliant. We prioritize your privacy from the very first phone call through your entire stay at our facility.
Which insurance plans do you accept?

blocks.html: We primarily work with major private insurance providers to help maximize your benefits and minimize out-of-pocket costs. Our specialists will perform a free, no-obligation verification of your policy to give you a clear understanding of your coverage before you arrive. If you do not have a private plan, we offer various private pay options and can discuss alternative ways to help you get the care you need. For more information, call us at 817-904-2197 so we can help you.

blocks.html: Yes. Our team is happy to assist with the logistics of getting to our Dallas campus. Whether you are traveling locally or from out of state, we can help coordinate transportation to ensure your arrival is as stress-free as possible.

What happens if I’m not sure which program I need?

blocks.html: That is what we are here for. During your initial clinical assessment, our experts will listen to your history and current challenges to recommend the appropriate level of care, whether that is medical detox, residential treatment, dual diagnosis or one of our specialized tracks.
